integrity: Exact identities and finite numerical checks are reproducible; infinite conclusions rest on the proof and on explicitly cited classical Laguerre asymptotics. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to radial operators on the one-variable true order-two polyanalytic Fock space; the full bounded-operator nullspace and higher Landau levels are outside scope. Complete historical priority and indirect equivalent reductions remain uncertain.
title: The sharp Schatten-four injectivity boundary for the radial true-polyanalytic Fock Berezin transform
